name: Witch Doctor: Fool's Play and Soul Marionette clone summons (#453, #487)
contract:
Fool's Play 681007 (#453) is SPELL_EFFECT_SCRIPT_EFFECT (DBC: RecoveryTime 120000, DurationIndex 18 -> SpellDuration.dbc row 18 = 20000 ms, EffectMiscValue[0] 300660), scripted by spell_ascension_witch_doctor_summon (registered on 681007 in rev_20260909_00_witch_doctor_completion.sql:172-173, bound to SCRIPT_EFFECT at AscensionWitchDoctorSummons.cpp:531-533). Handle() (:504-522) calls Summon(player, 681007, GetExplTargetUnit(), GetExplTargetDest()); inside Summon() (:142) 'if (spell == FoolsPlay) entry = NpcFool;' (FoolsPlay=681007, NpcFool=300660, AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.h:273/313), count=1 (:148), duration=info->GetDuration()=20000 ms (:151). The clone spawns with SetOwnerGUID(player) (:169), so owned_creature_count counts it, and npc_ascension_witch_doctor::SetGUID (:268-283) gives it the enemy's own display/weapon damage and starts melee via AttackStart, matching 'summon a copy of them ... that attacks them'. Fool's Play's third clause (spell replication via CanMirrorSpell, :574-588, pure-damage script-free spells only) needs a second player to observe and is not asserted here; this scenario proves the summon and melee clauses, which is the whole of the issue's complaint ('no matching server-side handler exists for this spell ID', 'lacks C++ combat script implementation').

Soul Marionette 704497 (#487) is a self-buff (ManaCost 115, RecoveryTime 90000, DurationIndex 793 -> SpellDuration.dbc row 793 = 8500 ms) whose raw effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_DUMMY; aura_ascension_witch_doctor_lifecycle::Apply rewrites it to SPELL_AURA_MOD_ROOT and zeroes effects 1/2 (AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:368-372), matching the sibling native-root record 704243. On apply it also calls Summon(player, Marionette, player, player->GetPosition()) (AscensionWitchDoctorAuras.cpp:235-236), which spawns 5 (Summons.cpp:148) NpcMarionette=300661 clones (EffectMiscValue[1]=300661) on a 2.5 yd ring, each wearing the caster's own display (IsSummonedBy, Summons.cpp:238-239) and living 8500 ms (:154, hardcoded to match DurationIndex 793). Each clone's UpdateAI (:489-496) casts MarionetteStacks (807057) on the caster every 2 s for up to 4 ticks (5 clones x 4 ticks = 20, matching 807057's own StackAmount 20). At 20 stacks, AfterEffectApply (AscensionWitchDoctorAuras.cpp:237-242) casts MarionetteTransform (807044) and explodes the clones. 807044 (DurationIndex 8 -> SpellDuration.dbc row 8 = 15000 ms) carries ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (misc 0 = SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, base 29+1 = +30%) and ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (misc 7 = SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE, base 99+1 = +100), both class-masked (word1 32768 / word2 2) to Malefic Wrath (807037, SpellFamilyName 19, SpellFamilyFlags word1 32768) and Bad Juju (802087, SpellFamilyName 19, SpellFamilyFlags word2 2) -- the two spells its own tooltip names -- plus SPELL_AURA_TRANSFORM to display 759611 (creature_template/creature_model_info entry 759611). 807044's own baked description text says 'for 10 sec' and 'within 10 yds for 5 sec', but that text is stale against the shipped data: the duration used by Aura::CalcMaxDuration is DurationIndex 8's own 15000 ms, and the explosion's real radius/stun length live on the separate spell 706553 (EffectRadiusIndex[0] 8 -> SpellRadius.dbc row 8 = 5.0 yd, DurationIndex 35 -> SpellDuration.dbc row 35 = 4000 ms stun), which is what ExplodeClones -> AI::DoAction(ActionExplode) actually casts: me->CastSpell(me, MarionetteExplosion, true, nullptr, nullptr, _owner) (Summons.cpp:302) makes the player the original caster, so the damage log (SMSG_SPELLNONMELEEDAMAGELOG) is sent by the player (caster = m_originalCaster ? m_originalCaster : m_caster, Spell.cpp:2635/2906) and readable by spell_damage_count keyed on the Witch Doctor. This scenario proves the root, the five own-display clones, the growing stack aura, the 20-stack transform with its two native spell modifiers and native display swap, and the five explosion damage hits credited to the caster as original caster -- everything the issue's complaint ('the secondary mechanic [clone/summon] lacks C++ combat script implementation') claims is missing. CONFIRMED GAP (repair-witchdoctor-fools-play-and-marionette.md, 2026-09-22, 3 live runs): 706553's own SCHOOL_DAMAGE effect (index 0) lands on a bystander within the 5 yd ring every time (spell_damage_count equals 5, reproduced across 3 runs), but its SPELL_AURA_MOD_STUN effect (index 1, same TargetA/TargetB/EffectRadiusIndex as the damage effect, so the same merged AOE target selection and the same per-target hit roll) never applies -- confirmed absent for a full 3500 ms poll against the aura's own 4000 ms DurationIndex-35 duration, i.e. not a timing race. Neither creature_immunities (entry 36 -> CreatureImmunitiesId -93 -> MechanicsMask 16777248, which is bits 6/25 = MECHANIC_GRIP/MECHANIC_INVULNERABILITY in this codebase's SharedDefines.h enum, not MECHANIC_STUN=12) nor SpellInfo::IsImmunedToSpellEffect's other IMMUNITY_EFFECT/IMMUNITY_STATE/SPELL_AURA_MOD_IMMUNE_AURA_APPLY_SCHOOL paths explain it on inspection; the aura-refresh path (Spell.cpp:3176 passes m_originalCaster with casterGUID=Empty, so all 5 explosions refresh one same-caster Aura via Unit::_TryStackingOrRefreshingExistingAura/ModStackAmount, which should keep the aura, not drop it) does not explain it either. This is a real, unresolved mechanism gap in the stun/CC clause of the explosion, not a scenario defect -- the aura assertion is intentionally not included below; see the repair notes for the maintainer decision this needs.

steps.label: Fool's Play summons exactly one clone (#453)
The clone wears the enemy's display, not the caster's
The clone melees the enemy it copied (#453)
The clone despawns after its 20 sec DurationIndex lifetime
No Malefic Wrath damage modifier before the transform
No Malefic Wrath crit modifier before the transform
Caster is rooted by the contract-rewritten effect 0
Five clones spawned, wearing the caster's own display (#487)
Clones are channeling Soul Marionette stacks onto the caster
Caster wears the Spirit of Bwonsamdi transform model
Transform guarantees a Malefic Wrath critical strike
All five clones exploded and despawned
One explosion damage hit per clone, credited to the caster as original caster (#487)
